title: Implement stats dashboard and string search
description:
Enhance stats and query commands:
- psp-etl stats: images per vendor, entries per generation, encryption rates, score distributions
- psp-etl query --string 'spiRead': search strings table
- Cross-vendor diff view: same firmware version, different md5, compare string sets
- Rich formatted output with tables and charts
- Depends on: db.py, primary image selection
